articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of Movie Reviews Using Heterogeneous Features
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Human disposition has always influenced by others suggestion and reviews. People are always eager to know other's reviews for their profit but, every website contains a very large amount of review text, the average human reader will have trouble in identifying relevant sites, extracting and abstracting the reviews so they cannot reach to the right decision in less time that is why automated sentiment analysis systems are required. In the proposed approach, heterogeneous features such as machine learning based and Lexicon based features and supervised learning algorithms like Naive Bayes (NB) and Linear Support Vector Machine (LSVM) used to build the system model. From implementation and observation, conclude that using proposed heterogeneous features and hybrid approach can get an accurate sentiment analysis system compared to other baseline system. In future for big data, we can use these heterogeneous features for bulding advance and more accurate models using Deep Learning (DL) algorithms.

articleTitle: PPG Based Heart Rate Algorithm Improvement with Butterworth IIR Filter and Savitzky-Golay FIR Filter
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Heart Rate is an important physiological parameter for health monitoring. Heart Rate Measurement with smart phone is used by many people all over the world and different applications are developed. Mobile camera detects Electro Magnetic radiation at 350-1000nm wavelengths & in that wavelength range, 700-1000nm is IR radiation. Infrared is a special form of invisible electromagnetic wave that can be felt by heat. Visible light's wavelength is 400-700nm. Here in our study, we have focused on Non-Invasive PPG signal based HeartRate monitoringfrom skin blood flow using IR light at 900 nm wavelength. The PPG is obtained from RED channel of the captured live video of smart phone camera as RED channel video is stable than Green & Blue channel. We have captured contact red videoto obtain PPG using smart phone and developed algorithm to remove some percentoftouch errors and followed by smoothening with Savitzky-Golay FIR filter, noise reduction with 2nd Order Butterworth (IIR) band pass filter, leakage reduction with Hanning window and FFT analysis of noise free smooth PPG signal.

articleTitle: Development of GUI for Text-to-Speech Recognition using Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Natural language processing is a widely used technique by which systems can understand the instructions for manipulating text or speech. In the present paper, a Text-to-speech synthesizer is developed that converts text into spoken word, by analysing and processing it using Natural Language Processing (NLP) and then using Digital Signal Processing (DSP) technology to convert this processed text into synthesized speech representation of the text. Here we developed a useful text-to-speech synthesizer in the form of a simple application that converts inputted text into synthesized speech and reads out to the user which can then be saved as an mp3 file.

articleTitle: Provisioning Technical Interoperability within ZigBee and BLE in IoT Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: The increment growth of diverse devices in Internet of Things (IoT) technology where all the wireless devices are capable for low cost, low power, low energy, low data transfer, privacy and high security. The efficient way to communicate among and collect the huge amount data from diverse heterogeneous devices is one of the challenges of future IoT. IoT interoperability among such (BLE, ZigBee, Wi-Fi, Z-Wave etc.) Heterogeneous devices are a big challenging task, especially in some critical-application. Interoperability should be considered by both IoT Devices and application developers to ensure the delivery of service to all customers or users regardless on the specification of hardware that they are used. In this paper we focuses on Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) and ZigBee wireless technology protocols of IEEE 802.15.1, IEEE 802.15.4 standards over IPv6 for interoperability between this two. This paper also includes different wireless protocols, similar services and tradeoffs.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Unidirectional and Bidirectional Buck-Boost Converter Using PID Controller
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: The main aim of this paper is to analyze the dynamic response, performance, deportment of unidirectional and bidirectional buck-boost converters for both buck and boost modes. In the unidirectional BBC, power flow in single direction whereas in BBBC power flow in both the direction. PID controller is designed to obtain the fine output response with less percentage overshoot. Unidirectional BBC has a wide range of voltage variation and bidirectional BBC has high energy density. The result will be obtained and validate with the help of Simulink software named as MATLAB and SIMULINK.

articleTitle: An efficient way of implementing high speed 4-Bit advanced multipliers in FPGA
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: ALU in Digital processor is the important block as all the computational operations carried out by this. A multiplier is an electronic circuit used in any computing device for multiplication of two binary numbers. Multiplication of 4-bit numbers is a lengthy procedure if we go the conventional way. In this paper, two 4 bit multipliers purposed namely Unsigned Array Multiplier and Wallace Tree Multiplier. The Wallace tree method is highly pipelined and saves a lot of time. Individual components of both the devices are optimized and have been used to construct the multipliers. The designed circuit is implemented in FPGA (BASYS-3 ARTIX-7). The delay obtained in Wallace multiplier is 6.86ns,49.35<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> reduction in delay compared to previous literature. Also, the power consumption is also very low(3.81watt) for Wallace tree multiplier.

articleTitle: Design of Binary to Gray Code Converter for Error Correction in Communication Systems Using Layered Quantum Dot Cellular Automata
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Due to the expeditious growth of digital industry, the transistor based CMOS technology endures serious challenges due to the scaling of the device dimensions at nano scale. Quantum Dot Cellular Automata is an emerging domain in the province of nanotechnology that uses quantum dots to process and transfer information which works on the combined postulates of quantum mechanics and cellular automata to overcome the disputes of the transistor technology. This paper has demonstrated the use of Layered T gate for designing binary to gray code converter based on Quantum Dot Cellular Automata. The paper has also presented the application of binary to gray code converter for error corrections in communication systems. The proposed design is superior as compared to the existing designs in terms of cell count, area and latency. The layout has been generated and functionality of the design has been verified using the QCA Designer simulation tool.

articleTitle: Improved Adaptive Cooperative Spectrum Sensing in Cognitive Radio Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: We know that there is an issue for spectrum resources being unavailable because of increasing wireless services. To solve this a newer intelligent technology have been developed called as Cognitive Radio (CR). This technology inculcates the use of spectrum holes that occur due to the underutilization of the licensed spectrum. The identification of the spectrum holes can be done by using a method known as spectrum sensing. There are a variety of issues faced by individual CRs in precise spectrum sensing such as hidden terminal problem, shadowing and multipath fading. In order to facilitate the eradication of these issues a newer design of cooperative spectrum sensing have been developed called as Cooperative Spectrum Sensing (CSS). In this a particular weight have been designated to each CR participating in the process to classify according to reliability. Instead of using the conventional threshold equation an adaptive threshold equation have been devised for the initial energy detection algorithm and utilizing the adaptive threshold equation we have designed our algorithm.

articleTitle: Amar Bangladesh - a Machine Learning Based Smart Tourist Guidance System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Tourism is a very prominent sector for many third world countries around the world as a greater portion of their economy is dependent on it. In countries like Bangladesh, who are blessed with enriched natural beauty, are often lagging behind to attract more tourists both by private and government organizations. Amar Bangladesh is the first tourism-based smart phone application to introduce machine learning in its program. The mobile application uses the Google Maps API and finds out the location of all points of interest added to the database by the Admin. An user will be able to log in to this app using their basic information or Facebook details. Upon logging in, users will plan their day long trips starting from the nearest attraction. They can deselect attractions which they do not prefer. The ML program used in this application will find the most suitable routes to reach the destinations one by one. Suggestions developed through machine learning would appear each time while choosing their points of interest. Users will also be able to write notes as a mean of diary entry which will be saved on their phones offline database. Users may allow public access to those entries or restrict them from sharing too.

articleTitle: Solid State Transformer for Electrical System: Challenges and Solution
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: After the evolution of SST, it plays vital role in the field of modern electrical power system. It has numerous benefits of small volume, weight, size, fault segregation and added some others functions and enhanced power quality such as voltage regulation, reactive power compensation, fault isolation, voltage unbalance, sag and swell. The idea of SST and its topology has been discussed in earlier papers and their main work focused on advancement of its topology, with the advancement of technology and how it can be used for improvement of exiting technology. In this paper discuss about the features of power electronic based solid state transformer and its application in different electrical field, where conventional transformer is replaced by the solid state transformer.

articleTitle: Demonstration of T-Shaped Channel Tunnel Field-Effect Transistors
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: In this paper we have proposed a novel structure T-shaped channel TFET., which is experimentally demonstrated for the first time and investigated its performance and conduct. This structure have surpassing advantages over planar conventional TFET in terms of recorded lower OFF current and thus significant suppression of ambipolar conduction and improved ON current and thus higher Ion/Ioff ratio. Three such T-shaped channel structures are simulated and named according to the material used: Silicon based-T Channel-Dual Gate TFET (Si-TC-DG-TFET), Silicon-Gallium Arsenide based-T Channel-Dual Gate TFET (Si-GaAs-TC-DG-TFET) and Gallium Arsenide based-T Channel-Dual Gate TFET (GaAs-TC-DG-TFET). All the fundamental device parameters are analyzed for comparative study to obtain appropriate material that can be used to get optimized results and complex investigate and demonstrate the effects of T-Channel approach which has commanding outcomes on all characteristics in a 2D TFET model. All the simulations are done in Silvaco, Atlas.

articleTitle: Wearable DGS Integrated High Performance Compact Antenna for 2.4 /5.2/5.8 GHz WLAN Band on Leather Substrate
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: A compact high performance tri-band coaxial probe fed microstrip antenna with two L shaped defected ground structures (DGS) for wireless local area network applications is proposed. In this paper, a rectangular microstrip antenna is designed for 5.8 GHz WLAN band (5.725-5.825 GHz),(1.7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>). Now, two L shaped DGS structures are suitably introduced for achieving two additional frequency bands at 2.4 GHz, i.e. the Bluetooth band (2.4-2.48 GHz),(3.2 %) and 5.2 GHz, i.e. the first WLAN band (5.15-5.35 GHz),(3.8%). The fabricated prototype of the proposed antenna has an overall size of 22.2 mm × 18.4mm. The integrated DGS structures also improve the performance of the antenna. Experimental results show that the antenna has good directional patterns and gains over the three frequency bands. In addition, the effect of the variation of different parameters of the proposed antenna with DGS structures on its electromagnetic performance is extensively studied and discussed in detail. The proposed multiband microstrip antenna is thus compatible for functioning at three application specific frequency bands simultaneously.

articleTitle: Anti-windup FOPI Controller for Step Motor
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: The performance of anti-wind up fractional order proportional integral (FOPI) controller is tested on step motor. Generally, stepper motor can convert digital signal to angular position. Therefore, controlling of stepper motor is required for precise position with its quicker zero speed tracking performance. By considering practical control limits due to presence of saturation type nonlinearity in the design of step motor control, anti-wind up technique with the conventional controller can be taken to avoid the integrator wind up phenomenon. Here, a modification is done by replacing integer order integrator by using fractional one. PID controller has three fixed parameters. By controlling additional fractional parameters, performance can be improved. Here, by taking this advantageous characteristic of fractional parameters, anti-wind up FOPI controller is developed to achieve faster zero speed response with better tracking reference position.

articleTitle: IMU based Accident Detection and Intimation System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Road traffic accidents are the biggest causes of transport related fatalities in the world. Delay in EMS (emergency medical services) to the affected is the leading cause of fatalities in such cases. The first step to minimise this delay is to have an automated system to detect an accident and intimate its location and severity to the EMS, which can then take necessary action to reach the site at the earliest. This work deals with the development of a low cost standalone system that can be placed in any vehicle to detect a crash scenario and intimate its severity and location to an EMS. The objective is to make this system compatible and affordable for lower-end and older vehicles. The system was tested and implemented on a dummy wheeled robot to verify the algorithms.

articleTitle: Circular Microstrip Patch Antenna with U-slots for multi band application
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: In this research work a Circular Microstrip Patch Antenna designed and the circular patch of the antenna slotted with U-slots, that enabled it to generate five resonant bands for penta band application. The antenna had exited using coxial probe with proper probe position. From IGHz to 5GHz frequency range over which the designed antenna had been investigated and within this frequency range the antenna generated multiple resonant bands with center frequencyl.02GHz, 1.66GHz, 2.55GHz, 3.7GHz and 4.93GHz. HFSS commercial software used to simulate the above said antenna for evolution of input impedance, Sn, Gain and Radiation Pattern.

articleTitle: Simulation of carbon nanotubes polymer based piezoresistive flexible pressure sensor for ultra sensitive electronic skin
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: The design and sensitivity of a piezoresistive pressure sensor based on single-walled carbon nanotubes-polymer nanocomposite and multi-walled carbon nanotubes-polymer nanocomposite has been investigated. The paper dwells on the nuances of modeling flexible piezoresistive pressure sensor using COMSOL Multiphysics Finite Element Modeling (FEM) software. The response of each of the above sensor has been simulated for pressure loading (0-130 Pa). The simulation results show an increase in the resistance of piezoresistive material with an increase in the application of pressure. The obtained piezoresistive response of both carbon nanotubes based sensors is compared.

articleTitle: Single Image Visibility Restoration Using Dark Channel Prior and Fuzzy Logic
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Contrast, and colour-fidelity of images degraded by heavy fog should be restored to aid the ever emerging fields of computer vision applications. The revolutionary advent of self-driven cars has made it increasingly urgent that efficient and fast enhancement techniques be developed. Accumulation of dense fog is also a major contributor to road accidents. CCTV surveillance, object tracking, and Fog Vision Enhancement System (FVES) are other areas that can be facilitated by such algorithms. Standard filtering techniques that fail to effectively restore low contrast foggy images must be replaced with time-efficient special enhancement techniques. In this paper, we have used the Dark Channel Prior (DCP), which is the most renowned prior for fog removal. This prior assumes that a fog-free, clear image has intensity value close to zero in at least one colour channel. Although DCP effectively restores most of the colour information, it fails to enhance the contrast of the image. To overcome this shortcoming, we have proposed a Fuzzy Logic based Contrast Enhancement algorithm, which converts the image into the fuzzy domain and performs spatial operations on the image to restore the contrast adequately.

articleTitle: Building of Low Cost Reliable Wireless Sensor Network for Smart Indoor Agriculture Products
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: This paper is based on Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) for indoor agricultural applications. The system consists of sensor node, router and gateway. The sensor nodes collect the data from various sensors and send the data to gateway through router. The sensors data are received at the gateway, which is visible to the user through personal computer or laptop. When the sensor data lies above a certain value then the actuator comes, this takes necessary action to normalize (calibrate) the nodes and hence to develop a closed loop control system. Active buzzer alarm warns the user if the temperature rises above certain level. Solenoid valve is used to water plants as per plants requirements. To make the WSN design reliable an alternate routing path is attached to each node.

articleTitle: Metamaterial unit cell with negative Refractive Index at C band
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: A novel configuration of left handed metamaterial (LHM) unit cell based on microstrip line loaded split ring resonator (SRR) has been proposed. Unit cell is optimized to get negative refractive index using a Full wave 3D electromagnetic simulator. The proposed unit cell exhibits negative refractive index over 5.7GHz to 6GHz frequency band. The unit cell structure has low profile and occupies volume of 17x17x1<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7mm</sub>3.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Arithmetic Multipliers
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Multipliers play an important role in today's digital signal processing and various other applications. The arithmetic multipliers are used in several kinds of processors and their architecture needs to be optimized for enhancing the performance. With advancement in technology, various high speed and low power multipliers are being designed having less area and optimized layout. In this paper a comparative study is made based on the three multipliers mainly Array, Wallace Tree and Booth multipliers and the design is done using verilog in Vivado 2017.4.1 platform. This paper can bring an idea for the beginners working on architecture design in VLSI. The above said multipliers are implemented on xc7a100tcsg324-1 board.

articleTitle: Low Power implementation of Multi-Bit Hybrid Adder using Modified GDI Technique
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Adders are the main component of the digital devices. Day by day the devices are advancing in terms of performance, which leads to minimization of the area as well as faster computational speed along with least dissipation of energy. The modification is carried out to speed up the devices, make them less power consumptive and compact with respect to area. So, in order to implement these changes, we have to primarily design a power efficient adder capable of computing multiple bits at a given time frame, as adders are one of the indispensable part of any digital system. Some of the techniques which have been employed to make adders more efficient are CMOS, PTL, GDI (Gate Diffusion Input). GDI has better features with respect to PTL and CMOS as it reduces the number of transistors required to implement logic gates and simple digital blocks. In this paper we have designed a low power multi-bit hybrid adder with the help of Modified Gate Diffusion Input (m-GDI) technique and also presented a comparative study between various other adders and their techniques of implementation the simulation results have been obtained using DSCH 3.8, the design is further verified and simulated using Verilog HDL in Xilinx ISE 14.7 environment.

articleTitle: Wind Speed Forecasting using Different Neural Network Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: The wind energy generation depends upon the nature of direction of wind and varying wind speed. This paper presents the comparison of different wind speed forecasting algorithms i.e. Regression Method and Neural Network (different neural network algorithms- 1. Levenberg-Marquardt 2. Bayesian Regularization 3. Scaled Conjugate Gradient.). Matlab tool is used to find the result of these methods which is compared by minimum MAPE (Mean Absolute Percentage Error). To implement these algorithms we take 6 month data of wind speed. The Bayesian Regularization algorithm has the least MAPE which is approx. 3.4%.

articleTitle: Assessment of Resource Potential and Feasibility Study of Standalone PV-Wind-Biogas Hybrid System for Rural Electrification
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Ethiopian Electric Power Corporation utility company uses extension of grids and installation of diesel generators as an option for the electrification of rural villages. Despite the tremendous efforts exhibited during the past few years, there are still exceedingly many people without access to electricity services. Grid extension to rural areas is either financially not viable or practically not feasible as these locations are geographically isolated and have a very low power demand in the country. The use of diesel generators has also harmful effect on the environment in addition to their higher cost of fuel, maintenance and operation. Consequently, rural areas are dependent on local solutions for electricity supply. However, the Adama area has renewable energy resources, such as Wind, Solar and Biogas with the capability of providing the needed power demand without requiring the extension of the national grid. In this study, assessment of resource potential and feasibility study of PV-Wind-Biogas hybrid system with battery storage as a backup is studied to electrify the village in Adama rural area. Electric load estimation for the basic needs of the community are considered. The hybrid energy system optimized by HOMER is cost effective to electrifying the village.

articleTitle: Voltage quality Compensation of DFIG with Series DVR (SDVR) Under three phase fault
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: In present era, the fastest growing resource of renewable energy is wind energy. In spite of that wind energy is cheapest source of electrical energy, but it has some power qualities issues like harmonics, voltage sag, swell, voltage unbalanced etcetera, when it is in operation with load. In this paper, the controlling of grid connected doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG) with series dynamic voltage restorer (SDVR) under unbalanced voltage conditions is analyzed by SRF and PWM control technique. SDVR is most efficient, emphatic, simple control, fast response and low-cost custom power devices to mitigate the unbalance condition of voltage. Three phase a-b-c fault present in the line voltage can be compensated using SDVR circuit. It also compensates the three-phase fault through the constant frequency based hysteresis controller and improves the compensating output voltage at load point as compared to SRF method. Harmonics of the load point (THD) is also below the IEEE standard. By improving the unbalance condition of voltage which arises in the grid the power quality have been improved through the MATLAB/Simulink software.

articleTitle: Reactive Power Compensation of Solid State Transformer for WECS
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Series of power electronic based high frequency transformer i.e. Solid state transformer (SST) is one of the most emerging technologies for renewable energy integration. In wind energy conversion system (WECS) the fundamental frequency steps up transformer is replaced by advanced power electronic based solid-state transformer with advantage of smaller size and improved power quality. In this paper a configuration presents that combines the DFIG based wind turbine and SST operation. SST has three stage that is AC-DC, DC -DC (dual active bridge with high frequency transformer) and DC-AC. In this paper SST improve power qualities that is compensate reactive power, harmonic and unity power factor from dc-ac converter, by using hysteresis current control without using PLL thus the proposed system can eliminate the use STATCOM in DFIG based WECS and the system meets the recent grid code requirement of wind turbine.

articleTitle: Designing of Rectangular Microstrip Patch Antenna at 2.48Ghz Frequency for IRNSS Application
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to design rectangular microstrip patch antenna with resonating frequency of 2.48Ghz. The proposed antenna is fed using coaxial cable and has a bandwidth of 40.3Mhz which constitutes the s-band. The construction of the antenna is done using Roger RT Duroid 5880, whose dielectric constant is 2.2. It has a size of 100×90 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and thickness of 3.199mm. ANSOFT HFSS simulator is used for designing and simulating the proposed antenna. Other various antenna parameters such as VSWR, return loss, radiation pattern and are analysed to characterize the proposed antenna.

articleTitle: A simple Star shaped Microstrip Patch Antenna for penta band application
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: In this research paper a simple Star shaped microstrip patch antenna has been designed for penta band application. Proper placement and positioning of the co-axial probe leads to the production of five resonant frequency bands by the designed antenna. The above said antenna investigated between 1 to 5GHz frequency range, generated five resonant bands with center frequency 1.64GHz, 2.21GHz, 2.99GHz, 3.43 GHz and 4.25GHz. The designed antenna is simulated using HFSS commercial software for evolution of S11, Radiation pattern, Gain and input impedance.

articleTitle: IoT Based Patient Guidance System using Raspberrypi
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: This paper presents a novel idea for caring patients staying isolated at home. Accurate diagnosis and prompt medical treatment is essential for the survival of patients. It is not always possible to keep a patient in a medical center and in touch with a doctor due to high cost. The IoT based on Raspberrypi monitors round the clock the health parameters using related sensors and conveys information to a remote place. Automatic actuation of emergency medical or home appliances is also provided to give the patient a temporary relief.

articleTitle: A Novel Design and Implementation of Automated Feeding Mechanism in Fish Aquariums
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Smart fish feeding is used in the fishery business for its efficiency and standard maintenance. A proper device consisting of both manual operation and remote access in the context of household aquariums is not available in the market. We have designed a device which enables both manual and automated operation using a microcontroller. The user can easily set the time with the keypad to dispense food in the aquarium. It is also possible to remotely control the food dispenser via a website. The device has two chambers, the top one holds the fish food and the bottom one contains the motor operated rotating fish food dispenser. A servomotor controls the amount of food that can enter the bottom chamber from the top chamber. The rotating mechanism in the bottom chamber has a worm nail with spiral grooves, which dispenses the right amount of food to the aquarium water when the nail is rotated clockwise using a 12 volt gear motor. Overall, the design is low-cost, compact, easy to move and can be latched to any aquarium easily. This device should be very useful to people who leave their houses for a prolonged period for vacations or official business.

articleTitle: Automatic Identification of Fracture Region within Bone in X-ray Image
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: One of the common problem in human beings is bone fracture which occurs due to high pressure applied on bone or simple accident. It may also be due to bone cancer and osteoporosis. Hence the accurate diagnosis of bone fracture is very important aspects in medical field. In this paper X-ray images has been used for bone fracture analysis. The aim of this paper is to develop a processing technique for identification of fracture region within bone in x-ray image which was obtained from medical institute. Result obtained demonstrates the performance of processing technique.

Author Keywords: en d point detection and traversal

articleTitle: SIW Based Two Element Semi-Circular MIMO Antenna
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: In this paper, a two element MIMO antenna based on substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) technology is explored. SIW technology is a cutting-edge technology of which the PMC wall is responsible for radiation and PEC wall prevents the unwanted radiation loss. Using the concept of PEC and PMC wall a two element MIMO antenna is designed here. Port isolation between two antennas is noticed as -31 dB for resonant frequency. The proposed antenna gives peak gain of 4 dBi.

articleTitle: Analysis of Switching Topology for Advanced Isolated Bi- Directional DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: In this paper, the controlling methods of IBDC is analyzed which increases the overall performance of the IBDC. The IBDC power conversion is based on the high frequency link because it has many advantages over low frequency power conversion like reliability, less noise without effecting efficiency, high power density, light weight and cost. The usage of IBDC is continuously increasing for the various applications for the interfacing of the renewable energy resource to the HEV, UPS and utility grid systems. The power conversion is controlled by the using various phase angle control strategy. In this phase angle control strategy, the phase shift is provided between the input and output side of the transformer. For increasing the efficiency, different control strategy is used the discussed method are the basic of the controlling of IBDC other control strategy may be derived from these discussed methods. The analysis of control strategy has been done and discussed the strategy which increases the efficiency and the other factor.

articleTitle: Dielectric Properties of Alumina based Epoxy Composites for Electrical Insulation
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Epoxy resin is widely used polymeric insulating material in power engineering applications including transformer and machine insulation, GIS spacers, bushing, cable terminations etc. Addition of micro and nano particles in base matrix is in common practice since last few decades aiming to improve electrical, thermal and mechanical properties of insulating material. In this paper dielectric properties of epoxy composites such as dielectric constant, dielectric loss and volume resistivity were investigated at different alumina filler loading. Experiments were performed to measure dielectric constant and dielectric loss as a function of frequency. Further DC volume resistivity was measured using high resistance meter and resistivity cell. Results indicate decrement in permittivity and dielectric loss at low filler loading of nano particles. Further, with increase in filler concentration permittivity tends to increases. In case of DC volume resistivity for all the epoxy composites resistivity is found lower than the neat epoxy resin.

articleTitle: Design of a Pattern Reconfigurable Switched Parasitic Array for Null Steering Application
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: With the evolution of technologies like cognitive communication and beam division multiple access, the scope of smart antennas is increasing. In this direction, electrically steerable parasitic array radiator (ESPAR) antennas are emerging as a substitute for traditional bulky phased arrays. This work proposes an 8-element switched parasitic array (SPA) which consists of an active octagonal patch antenna element surrounded by seven rectangular patches as parasitic elements. The elements are connected to the active patch using PIN diode switch. By turning ON or OFF different switch connected to the active element, the radiation pattern of the antenna can be altered. When three consecutive elements are connected to the active element at a time, the SPA yields a wide beam and a null in the opposite direction. By selecting different sets of three consecutive parasitic elements, the beam and the null can be steered.

articleTitle: Neonatal Sepsis Prediction Model for Resource-Poor Developing Countries
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Out of 5 million global neonatal deaths annually 96% of them occur in developing countries. Majority of these deaths are due to sepsis. Blood culture which is a gold standard to diagnose sepsis is time consuming and nearly takes 24-72 hours. To save time, prediction models/screening tests are used to start antimicrobial therapy. Most of the prediction models require invasive parameters to predict sepsis. But rural areas of developing countries lack laboratory facilities. Therefore, these prediction models cannot be implemented in these areas. In this retrospective study, binary logistic regression was used to develop and compare two prediction models using invasive and non-invasive parameters. The data for this study was taken from Medical Information Mart for Intensive care (MIMIC) III database. An Android application was developed to calculate the probability of sepsis after manually entering the independent parameter values. Prediction model developed from non-invasive parameters performed equally well as compared to prediction model made from invasive parameters. The AUROC in derivation dataset were 0.777 and 0.824 in case of invasive and non-invasive prediction models respectively whereas they were 0.830 and 0.824 in case of validation dataset. Both models were significant with p<;0.001.

articleTitle: Characteristics study of high-K gate stack for MOS-FETs using TCAD Simulation
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Higher integration density and performance optimization are essential parameters in today's IC fabrication technology. As a result, the scaling down of MOS-FET devices to lower nano-meter regime incorporates stability issues. Various short-channel effects result in greater leakage current and power dissipation in modern system on chips (SoC). It has been observed the majority of leakage current caused by gate leakage that increases with decrease in feature size at submicron range. In order to minimize the gate leakage current high-K dielectric gate oxides are being used. In this paper, the high-K gate stacks have been used at interfacial oxide layer of n-MOSFET devices. The simulated result provides idea about the suitable combinations of gate oxides to lower the leakage current for 28 nm, 22 nm, 14 nm and 10 nm technology nodes. MINIMOS-NT Global TCAD simulation software has been used to obtain the results.

articleTitle: Multi-crystal Achromatic Quarter Wave Retarder for the Air-Multiangle Spectropolarimetric Imager (AirMSPI) in SWIR region
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Air Multiangle Spectro-Polarimetric Imager (MSPI) is an instrument for multi-angle polarization imagery which is used for the Aerosol-Cloud-Ecosystem (ACE) mission introduced by NASA. It was installed in ER-2 aircraft. The main component of the instrument is an achromatic quarterwave retarder with two photo elastic modulator. In this present communication we propose a four-element multi-crystal (Calcite; Quartz; KDP; Rutile) quarter wave retarder for SWIR range extending from 1000-2300 nm with retardance variation of 90°±1.25°. It is optimized for 1000, 1500, 2000 and 2300 nm.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Cladding Etched Fiber Bragg Grating based Refractive Index Sensor
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: An efficient fiber optic refractive index sensor based on a cladding etched fiber Braggs grating is theoretically analyzed and simulated under the refractive index range of 1.32-1.46. The simulation results show that the effective refractive index of the core mode decreases exponentially as the cladding thickness is reduced by means of etching technique. Furthermore, the sensitivity of the sensor is improved due to reduction in cladding radius and with the increase in surrounding refractive index. The shift in the Bragg wavelength (RED Shift) occurs due to increase in effective refractive index which increases with surrounding refractive index.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Frequency Selective Surface Integrated Circular Disc Antenna
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: In this paper, a novel stop-band single layer frequency selective surface (FSS) integrated with a low profile $/10 circular disc antenna has been proposed. The peak gain of the circular disc microstrip patch antenna undergoes an improvement of 7 dB in the designed frequency range. The unit cell (6.5mm x 6.0mm) of the proposed FSS comprises four triangular patches enclosed in a square loop. The FSS is designed to give a wide stop band response from 7.5-11.5 GHz. The antenna is designed to give a peak gain of 7dB in the frequency range 6.1-8.7 GHz. The design concept has been demonstrated and experimentally verified using simulated results.

articleTitle: Strategic Deployment of Distributed Generation and DSTATCOM in Radial Distribution System Considering Reliability Aspect
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: At present scenario with the increase in load demand, a need for voltage profile enhancement, minimization of line losses and thereby increasing system overall reliability has increased enormously. Nevertheless, increasing the generation capacity of existing power station is limited due to various environmental and economic constrains which consequently calls for precise assessment of locally optimized solution. In this paper, the distribution system is reconfigured by simultaneous deployment of Renewable Distributed Generation (DG) and Distribution Flexible AC Transmission System (DFACTS) for the system voltage profile improvement, reliability and reduction of the line losses. A Modified Firefly Algorithm (MoFA) is proposed to procure the optimal location and size of DG and DSTATCOM (Distributed Static Compensator) considering improvement of voltage profile, reliability and line losses reduction. To increase the computational efficiency, performance analysis for optimal allocation of the devices is conducted only at the weaker zones of the system. Revamp Voltage Stability Indicator (RVSI) is used to identify the weakest zone/lines and the corresponding receiving end buses are identified as the weak bus. Voltage Profile Improvement Index (VPII) enhances the voltage profile. The real and reactive power losses are reduced by implementing Line Loss Reduction Index (LLRI). The proposed algorithm is compared with two other algorithms such as PSO (Particle Swarm Optimization) and GA (Genetic Algorithm). Result indicates MoFA exhibits better convergence rate, time and solution quality. The proposed approach is to be tested in IEEE 69-bus radial distribution system.

articleTitle: Pattern Synthesis of Large Numbered Beam-steered Linear Array Using Restricted Search Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Present article investigates pattern synthesis of large number beam-steered linear array. Multiple objectives of side lobe level reduction and beam-width narrowing have been considered as pattern synthesis objectives. Excitation amplitude and uniform inter-element spacing have been considered as design parameters to be optimized. Optimum values of the design parameters have been obtained using restricted search particle swarm optimization. Effectiveness of the optimization algorithm has been illustrated using design instances of 48 and 51 elements linear array. Further superiority of restricted search particle swarm optimization over conventional particle swarm optimization has been established through comparison.

Author Keywords: large numbered beam steered linear array

articleTitle: Design of Portable Indicator for Underground Mines Using 433 MHz Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: The mining industry is the backbone of various manufacturing and infrastructure industries. In order to maintain a safe working environment, a lot of parameters need to be monitored periodically in underground mines. Wired indicators in underground mines incur a lot of regular maintenance. In wired network, if the wire gets broken then data from multiple sensors may get damaged. In wireless communication, the environment of a certain area can be analyzed at a distance. This paper proposes a portable wireless indicator, which can display the measurement of various critical parameters of underground mines. The parameters that have taken into consideration are temperature, pressure, and humidity. This indicator can communicate with multiple transmitters at a time using an efficient polling multiple access methods.

articleTitle: An intelligent method for optimizing the street-light-intensity
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: The upcoming research work emphasizes on the conservation of energy as well as on the reduction of environmental pollution. This paper introduces an intelligent method for optimizing the street-light-intensity so as to reduce the CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>emission which, in turn, reduces the pollution of the environment. The working principle is based on the requirement of luminous energy at a particular moment of time. An automatic system is designed using ARDUINO which will switch ON or OFF the street lights at given time and also depending on the intensity of the ambient light. This system also detects the movement of vehicles and interrupts the system to increase the intensity of light on the road.

articleTitle: Plastic Surgery Face Recognition Using LBP and PCA Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Face recognition is the frequently explored subdomain in the domain of image processing. It is quite a challenge to identify faces which have gone under the knife. Existing face recognition approaches are unsatisfactory for faces which have undergone plastic surgery. This paper proposes an approach for recognition of such faces using PCA (Principle component analysis) for dimension reduction and LBP (Local binary pattern) for feature extraction from the facial region and periocular region. Experimental results using this approach on a real-life facial plastic surgery database are found to be more promising than existing approach.

articleTitle: A Prominent Smart Gas Meter
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Nowadays the whole world depends on the technology which is making life easier. The designed system has technological advancement. This paper is about a smart gas meter which ensures proper billing system for household and restaurant uses as well as to stop the misuse of gas. This GSM based smart gas meter system will be able to measure the amount of gas that has been used by users and will send a SMS to the user cell phone. The main advantage of this process is that it is cost efficient. GSM module, flow sensor, temperature sensor, Arduino, pressure sensor, Hall Effect sensor etc. are used in this project. GSM module is used to send SMS to the users. SMS will be sent to the users and the suppliers for refilling the gas cylinder and the message will be sent automatically to the user cellphone about their monthly uses of gas. The aim of this system is show how easily gas can be measured with an automated smart system at a lower cost. The designed system is also user friendly and it will also make the users bill paying system easy.

articleTitle: Estimating Radar Backscatter from Water Wave Surface Using X Band FMCW Radar
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Information of the water wave properties is very important in a near shore region, in a ship, for level measurement in a tank, or for sea keeping and manoeuvring. In this work, we present a method based on X band radar using Linear Frequency Modulated Continuous Wave (FMCW) radar backscatter to estimate the various parameters of the wave like wave height, Doppler frequency, wave velocity, wave period, wind direction and possible way to detect breaking waves. Radar is developed at Society for Applied Microwave Electronic Engineering and Research (SAMEER) IIT BOMBAY campus. A wave tank has been used for experimentation in which probes generate water waves, The experiments are conducted at Hydraulics lab, Ocean Engineering department IIT Bombay.

articleTitle: Spectral Analysis of vowels of Adi Language of Arunachal Pradesh
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: In this paper, an attempt has been made to study the acoustic property of an Arunachali native language- Adi, being one of the most popular and highly spoken languages of Arunachal Pradesh. For this study, Adi digit sequences as speech samples uttered by Adis were taken. The spectrogram of the Adi speech samples and the formant frequencies of vowels like /a/,/e/, /i/,/é/,/í/,/o/ and /u/ are analyzed.

articleTitle: Design Optimization of CMOS Thermoelectric Energy Harvester for High Thermoelectric Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: This paper presents a design study of the optimization of Complementary Metal Oxide Semiconductor (CMOS) thermoelectric energy harvester (TEG). This paper discusses the impact on the output by changing the geometric parameters of the device like thickness, length and structure of the cavity. Design and analysis of the structure was carried out using ANSYS Multiphysics software. Simulation result reveals that the change in geometric parameters has a significant effect on output voltage, output current, power and heat absorbed by heat sink. It is also shown that thermoelectric efficiency of the device can be improved by proper design of the structural parameters of the model.

articleTitle: Effect of Self-Consistency Technique on Current Density Profile of Resonant Tunneling Diode
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: This paper reveals the importance of self-consistency technique for computing current density in resonant tunneling device. Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>Ga<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-x</sub>As/GaAs/Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">y</sub>Ga<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-y</sub>As structure is considered for simulation purpose, and both Schrödinger and Poisson's equations are simultaneously solved subject to appropriate boundary conditions to obtain current density as a function of externally applied bias. Structural parameters and material compositions within type-I range are varied to get the fluctuations in current, which is otherwise absent when calculation is performed without applying self-consistency technique. Findings are significant as magnitude of current obtained is higher than that obtained when self-consistency is absent. Result has immense importance for low bias application of RTD due to the presence of peaks at particular system compositions.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of 8-cavity hole-slot type magnetron in CST
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: In this study, the design and simulation of 8-cavity hole-slot type magnetron using the electromagnetic CST software has been presented. A magnetron simulation on CST particle studio represents three configurations like as Eigen-mode, Particle Tracking and Particle in Cell (PIC) Simulation. The first simulation ensures the mode excitation whereas remaining two simulations are required for the desired operation of magnetron. Here, the mathematical calculation of the 8-resonator system is compared with the simulation results to verify the accuracy of the theoretical results. In this paper, magnetron has been designed for X band where the impact of electric field with respect to frequency and time for PIC solver is investigated and found peak at 10GHz.

articleTitle: Enhancement of Continuous-Stirred Tank Reactor System Using Jaya Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: This paper deals with the optimization of a proportional-integrator-derivative (PID) controller aimed for the improvement of continuous-stirred tank reactor (CSTR) system which has now become an intrinsic part of process control industry. The complexity associated with the CS TR is the delayed response. The delay term has its own consequences, it stagnates the system's output. The system that has delay term is known as non-minimum phase system. The conventional control techniques are able to control the bounded delay term. As the delay term increases the chances of failing of conventional control techniques increases considerably. Thus, to cope up from this situation the parameters of the PID controller are optimized using some meta-heuristic approach known as JAY A algorithm. It's gaining popularity due to having less number of parameters. In fact, it is a parameter less approach, its keeps on rejecting the worst solution and tries to retain the best solution. Implemented technique is validated by comparing it with the conventional tuning approach. The conventional method incorporated here are Ziegler-Nichols, Skogested, Chen-Rhones, and Approximated MIGO. Finally, the controller is optimized by upgrading the parameters using JAYA algorithm which minimizes its performance index. The performance index used here is the integral time weighted square error (ITSE), the results are acquired using MATLAB/SIMULINK environment.

articleTitle: Microscopic Image Thresholding using Restricted Equivalence Function based Fuzzy Entropy Minimization and Bat Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Ubiquitous use of microscope in the field of medical diagnosis influences the development of automated systems. The inbuilt noise, illumination and contrast variations make microscopic image processing an emerging field of computer vision applications. This paper presents a novel and fast thresholding technique for microscopic data. To represent the inherent image vagueness, we use a fast processing fuzzy membership value generation technique using restricted equivalence function (REF). Then, a fuzzy entropy value is used to measure the total fuzziness present in the object and the background of the image. Finally, to search the optimal threshold value we use the well popular Bat algorithm. We have also implemented a multilevel thresholding technique for processing some complex fluorescence microscopy images. Experimental results on microscopic data and also on normal images show the superiority of the proposed thresholding technique. Experimental results on microscopic data and also on normal images show the superiority of the proposed thresholding technique. Proposed method is superior than other state-of-the-art methods not only in processing time but also in quantitative results. The proposed method is superior than other state-of-the-art methods not only in processing time, but also in quantitative results.

articleTitle: Beamforming in MIMO Radar using Coprime Array
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: This paper proposes a new method of beamforming for colocated MIMO radar. The method firstly constructs the coprime arrays in MIMO radar and then exploits the minimum variance distortionless response (MVDR) to maximize the power in the desired direction and minimize in other directions. Simulation results are presented to signify the beampattern and the signal to interference plus noise ratio performance of the proposed method. These performance characteristics are also compared with the earlier methods such as phased array radar, MIMO radar.

articleTitle: Lesion Segmentation Using Entropy Based Membership
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: The challenges faced in medical image processing makes image processing domain one of the active research areas nowadays. Brain tumors are aberrant growth formed by cells reproducing in an abnormal manner. Detecting the location of brain lesion (tumor) is essential as it helps in the diagnosis and cure of tumor. This paper proposes a novel clustering approach for the brain lesions in BRATS training 2017. This work is an advancement of a well-known Fuzzy C-Means (FCM) method to separate out different tissues of MR Brain images. Here, a novel membership function has been proposed. The evaluation of the adopted approach is compared using several validity functions with other state-of-the-art methods. The computational result on brain MR image shows that the proposed technique is powerful and precise than the standard FCM process. This proposed approach, based on entropy based variation of fuzzy membership function is able to handle uncertainty and vagueness in images by adopting new distance modification to calculate the optimum cluster for even mixed pixels. The method has been tested on BRATS 2017 training dataset. Compared to K-Means, K-Medoids and Fuzzy C-Means the proposed method significantly reduces the segmentation errors.

articleTitle: Synthesize and Characterization of Zinc Oxide Nanomaterial Specifically for Sensor Development
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: This work is about synthesis and characterization of Zinc Oxide nanomaterials for developing sensing layers. These layers are developed for sensing gases. The methodology is Ultrasonic probe method based on top-down approach. Ultrasonic waves are used to grind down macro-sized metal oxides to nano dimensions. The synthesized material is characterized using Electron microscopy, Spectroscopy, and Diffraction studies. The results are interpreted with respect to electric properties for exploration of sensitivity.

articleTitle: Design of Substrate Integrated Waveguide (SIW) BPF using Circular Ring, Split Ring and Inductive Posts
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Design of Substrate Integrated Waveguide (SIW) Band-pass Filter using circular rings, slotted rings and inductive posts are presented in this paper. These structures are analyzed separately to formulate their effects on creating higher cut-off within the microwave Ku bands. Significant isolation is achieved by using array of split ring structures embedded with reflection cancelling inductive vias. Major filter parameters of all configurations are studied and presented with comparative analysis. Maximum and minimum Insertion Loss of 1. SdB and O.4dB respectively has been achieved. Return loss and isolation > 10dB is also attained by the proposed technique.

articleTitle: A Two Element H-plane Hemispherical Dielectric Resonator Antenna Array
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: In this paper, a 1×2 H-plane hemispherical dielectric resonator antenna (HDRA) array is studied. Direct microstrip line (DML) fed technique is employed to excite the antenna elements. Firstly, we have designed an HDRA fed by DML. Next, we have designed a 1×2 dielectric resonator antenna with parallel feeding networks. Parallel feeding technique has been realized using a 3 dB power diver for equal power distributions in each antenna element. The single element antenna resonates at 6.4 GHz and offers impedance bandwidth of 6.25 %. This single element antenna gives peak gain of 5.4 dBi. For two elements antenna arrays, the impedance bandwidth and peak gain have been observed as 5.9 % and 8.11 dBi.

articleTitle: Design of 2's Complement of 4-Bit Binary Numbers Using Quantum Dot Cellular Automata
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Quantum Dot Cellular Automata is an emerging field in the domain of nanotechnology where circuits are designed in the nano level which are compatible to the circuits designed in traditional CMOS technology. Quantum Dot Cellular Automata gives a new dimension of ideas of designing basic gates in digital electronics with minimum hardware complexity. Transistor based CMOS designing faces many challenges due to the device dimension and leakage current but in QCA, quantum cells are in nano scale that contains quantum dots which help to transfer the information without any leakage current. This paper has demonstrated the design of 2' Complement of 4-bit binary numbers using layered and majority gate based Quantum Dot Cellular Automata. The calculation of kink energy has determined the stability of the circuit. The simulation results have been generated and verified using the QCA Designer tool.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Swastika-Slot Circular Patch Antenna for WLAN and WiMAX Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: This paper proposes a Swastika-slot circular patch antenna with multiband resonant frequencies having substantial gain and radiating properties. The proposed circular patch antenna specially designed for Wireless Local Area Network (WLAN) and Worldwide interoperability for Microwave Access (WiMAX) applications. The analyses were carried out using ANSOFT High Frequency Structure Simulator (HFSS). This antenna operates at 5.2 GHz corresponding to WLAN and 5.4/5.8 GHz corresponding to WiMAX band. Feeding technique used for this antenna is coaxial line feeding. Proposed antenna is characterized with better radiation pattern and highest gain of 19.77 dB. For each frequency band return loss graph and far field patterns are plotted with corresponding gain.

articleTitle: Performance of I-Shaped EBG Structures Over Low Loss Angular Bend Substrate Integrated Waveguide (SIW)
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Performance study of I-shaped periodic electromagnetic bandgap structures over Substrate Integrated Waveguide (SIW). The study has been performed over 90 degree bend SIW transmission line section in view of better integration ability within Microwave Integrated Circuits (MICs). Reflection loss arising due to waveguide bend is controlled by optimization of several useful parameters of end wall vias. Passband response including insertion loss and isolation is adjusted based on study of several EBG parameters produced in the parametric study section. The BPF operates within the microwave Ku-band with IL <; 1 db throughout the transmission passband with stopband isolation> 30 dB. All experiments are carried out over Neltec NH9320 material of thickness 0.8mm and dielectric constant of 3.2.

articleTitle: Voice Controlled Digital Thermometer for Medical Application
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: In this present work, voice controlled concept is added to the medical field. The device designed is handy and it can be used over a considerable distance. it is seen with progress of time that the basic health parameters that depicts the diagnosis takes time. Now with the help of this device doctors can know the condition of his patient, from a different room, or floor by sending a voice command and thus retrieving the information. This device can make work for them, convenient and prompt, and hence can treat the patient at the earlist.

articleTitle: Performance Study of Electronic Load Controller for Integrated Renewable Sources
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: This paper describes the performance of Electronic Load Controller (ELC) connected with hybrid hydro-wind system and examine the total harmonics distortion of the output voltage waveform. ELC used mainly for standalone generating stations. To maintain a desired output voltage magnitude and frequency of the modeled hybrid system a back to back converter with dc link capacitor is used. A dump resistor is also used in parallel with load to absorb excess power when demand of the load is reduced. This dump load is controlled by using a chopper circuit. This paper also present the MATLAB SIMULINK of hybrid hydro-wind system used with Electronic Load Controller.

Author Keywords: Hysteresis current controller and Total Harmonics Distortion (THD)

articleTitle: Control of Higher Order Modes and Their Radiation in Microstrip Antenna Using Extremely Compact Defected Ground Structure & Symmetric Stub
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Suppression of the radiation from higher order modes requires the elimination of those modes. In this paper, the elimination has been implemented with a novel miniaturized low pass filter (LPF) with high filter selectivity and wide stop band. Here, the fundamental operating frequency of the antenna falls in the pass band of the LPF. The attenuation of other higher order mode occurs since their frequencies fall in the LPF stop band. In this paper suppression has been carried out by using this LPF on antenna feed line. A successful demonstration has been presented to control the occurrence of higher order modes up to the second harmonic of the fundamental resonant frequency in a microstrip antenna. A miniaturized hair pin type defected ground structure (DGS) has been integrated to obtain elimination of higher order modes in the antenna at its microstrip feed level. A rectangular spiral type stub has been added to the feed line in order to improve the rejection characteristics.

articleTitle: Modelling and Simulation of Organic Photodetectors using Photonic Crystals
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Finite difference time domain (FDTD) modelling to improve the Electric field intensity of an Organic Photo detector (OPD) is reported by interposing a Photonic crystal with Brillouin zone on the emissive layer. A systematic approach had been presented towards FDTD modeling of an OPD structure. The use of Photonic crystal within the OPD structure improves the field intensity emanating from an OPD thereby resulting in higher generation rate. Photonic crystals which are useful to control optical properties of material, if incorporated within OPD structure, improves the power absorption from the OPD structure. Study has been carried out to analyze the effects on electric field intensity when Photonic crystal is interposed on the emissive layer. Enhanced electric field intensity is indicative of improved light extraction efficiency from an OPD. The power absorption, Far field intensity and Short circuit parameters of OPD with and without Photonic crystals (PC) was studied for various wavelengths of light particularly from 520-560nm and found that absorption is optimum for green light wavelength.

articleTitle: Combine Effect of Large and Small Scale Fading on the Performance of QAM
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Generalized K(KG) fading channel, with an arbitrary branch Selection Combining (SC) receiver have been studied, in which the issue of large scale fading, on the performance of quadrature amplitude modulation (QAM), over small scale fading is analyzed. It is found out that the (KG) fading model offers substantial improvement over the Nakagami-m fading model which can be seen as one of its special events. This highlights the effect caused on the performance due to the large scale fading which can be distinctly understood from the plots in the result and discussion section. Further Monte-Carlo simulation have been employed for the confirmation of the mathematical outcomes.

articleTitle: Total Error Reduction in Presence of Malicious User in a Cognitive Radio Network
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Primary user emulation (PUE) attack causes security issues in a cognitive radio network (CRN) while sensing the unused spectrum. In PUE attack, malicious users transmit an emulated primary signal in spectrum sensing interval to secondary users (SUs) to forestall them from accessing the primary user (PU) spectrum bands. In the present paper, the defense against such attack by Neyman-Pearson criterion is shown in terms of total error probability. Impact of several parameters such as attacker strength, attacker's presence probability, and signal-to-noise ratio on SU is shown. Result shows proposed method protect the harmful effects of PUE attack in spectrum sensing.

articleTitle: Adaptation of Spectral Clustering in Telecommunication Industry for Customer Relationship Management
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: The customers are the main entity of any business company and when it comes to telecommunication industry and its mature market, that number is too huge to be analyzed manually. That is where CRM analytics comes in the scenario, which helps in doing a better business. In this paper, we have analyzed a data-set of call records of 325 records, containing the attributes: directory number, called number, date, time, duration & units. Here we have used spectral clustering and k-means clustering to analyze the dataset to gain some information from the data to reach a certain conclusion. Considering this is a forward chaining research, there is no predefined target to be achieved. Here we have mainly done a comparative study between spectral clustering and k-means to see which one gives a better perspective of the data.

articleTitle: Study of variation in thickness of poly(n-vinylcarbazole) [PVK] thin films in different solvents for static dispense spin coating method
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: We report the effect of evaporation rate of solvents (chloroform and chlorobenzene) over the thickness of spin coated PVK thin films and turn-on voltage of fabricated organic light emitting devices(OLEDs). In our work, experiments are performed for static dispense spin coating procedure in which the dispensed drops of PVK solution are made to wait for a finite time before spinning. It is found that the high evaporation rate solvent has higher sensitivity to wait-time-to-spin as opposed to low evaporation rate solvent. The increased turn-on voltage for devices with high evaporation rate solvent proved that the thickness of PVK thin film increases with wait time for chloroform. We observed relatively lesser change in turn-on voltages for chlorobenzene based OLEDs possibly because of low evaporation rate resulting in smaller changes in thickness of PVK layer.

articleTitle: Triple Band Non-Linear Manipulated Sierpinski-Knopp Fractal Wide-Slot Microstrip Antenna with Inverted L-shaped Strip
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: In this paper, a compact open ended microstrip-line-fed antenna with Sierpinski Knopp wide-slot for triple band operation is designed and discussed. The proposed antenna consists of a 50Ω microstrip-line on one side and a Sierpinski Knopp fractal wide-slot as a defected ground structure on the other side of the substrate. The effect of elongation, a non-linear manipulation on antenna characteristics is analyzed. An inverted L-shaped strip is placed inside the wide-slot form a different current path for obtaining the 2.4 GHz WLAN frequency band. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed antennas resonates in three distinct frequency bands, i.e. 2.4-2.78 GHz, 3.32-4.03 GHz and 4.58-5.8 GHz centered around 2.61, 3.56 and 5.03 GHz respectively. The peak gain varies from 1.73 to 6.86 dB across all operating bands. The proposed antenna incorporates three different wireless standards in itself and offers a compact size of 21 × 32 × 1.6 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> as compared to earlier reported antenna structures.

articleTitle: Miniaturization of Rectangular Microstrip Antenna at WiMAX Band with Slot in Patch and Ground Surface
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: In the proposed work, a simple I shaped slot is integrated in the ground surface, as well as in the patch of a rectangular microstrip antenna, resonant at WLAN frequency band (i.e. 5.2GHz), which resulted in miniaturization of the antenna to WiMAX frequency band (i.e. 3.5GHz). The miniaturization percentage is calculated to be 54%. A comparative analysis has been presented in terms of return loss, gain and impedance parameters.

articleTitle: LabView Implementation of Ball and Beam System Using Cascade PD Control
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: The Ball and Beam system is a popular technique for the study of control systems. The system has highly non-linear characteristics and is an excellent tool to represent an unstable system. The control of such a system presents a challenging task. The ball and beam mirrors the real time unstable complex systems such as flight control, on a small laboratory level and provides for developing control algorithms which can be implemented at a higher scale. The objective of this paper is to design and implement cascade PD control of the ball and beam system in LabVIEW using data acquisition board and DAQmx and use the designed control circuit to verify results in real time.

articleTitle: A Study on Wavelet Based Image Fusion
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Image Fusion is a technique to merge information from several images and creates a better quality of image that is clearer and more informative than those previous images. Those images may come from different imaging devices, may have different kind of views or have different kind of intensity. Image Fusion has a lot of aspects like Medical aspects, Scientific aspects, Satellite Imaging, Planetary and Space research etc. A better quality and more informative image help researcher to have better decision making, sort intricate information and also help them to explore various kind of scientific discovery. For fusing image different kind of method has been taken by various authors at different time. Some of them have used wavelet based fusion with different kind of high pass or low pass filter and some of them have used other kind of approach. In this paper we represent fusion methods to get more informative medical image and then select and extract the interested area from that image for the sake of medical diagnosis.

articleTitle: Computing Surface Potential of Double Gate MOSFET for both Free and Doped Carrier Concentrations
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Surface potential of symmetric double gate MOSFET is analytically investigated by solving Poisson's equation subject to appropriate boundary conditions considering the presence of both free and doped carriers. Different semiconductors are considered for simulation purpose to find the change in potential w.r.t to the already existing results for Si, and carrier concentrations are modified within feasible limit to observe the variation. Simulations are also carried out at different temperatures in order to account the Joule heat effect at on-chip, and significant variations are observed. Result will play key role in determining drain current through DG MOSFET which satisfies Ortiz-Conde model.

articleTitle: Security Issues of a Three-Party Password Authenticated Key Exchange Protocol Resistant to Stolen Smart Card Attacks
